roles.title: Call Centre Specialist & Delighter
bullets: Served as first point of contact for a high-volume client base, handling everything from routine enquiries to complaints that needed careful de-escalation.
Focused on first-call resolution, since callbacks indicated something had gone wrong the first time; the goal was always to close issues properly on the first attempt.
Logged all interactions in the CRM system, feeding into a broader effort to identify recurring friction points and improve the overall service flow.

roles.title: Manager & LMIS Encoder
bullets: Oversaw day-to-day data operations for overseas worker placement, encoding worker profiles and tracking logistics movements through the LMIS platform.
Maintained system integrity during a chaotic operational period, which was not straightforward given inconsistent data quality from upstream sources.
Produced periodic reports for internal planning and strategic decision-making, supporting resource allocation and operational continuity.

roles.title: Public Health Intern
bullets: Rotated through internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and paediatrics, gaining hands-on exposure to clinical decision-making under real resource constraints.
Developed a clearer understanding of where public health interventions land in practice versus how they are framed in theory, particularly in under-resourced settings.
Supported departmental administration and patient education alongside medical staff, bridging clinical workflows and community health considerations.

roles.title: Translator & Customer Resolver
bullets: Resolved complex complaints and technical issues across language barriers, translating not just words but the underlying customer concern versus the formal issue on record.

roles.title: Customer Service & IT Systems Officer
bullets: Supported customer service functions and IT system operations in a formal government environment, gaining early exposure to structured, process-driven working practices.
